name: flaky-test-hunter
description: Finds the flaky tests in a repository's recent CI history. It reads the last N runs of a workflow (default 30), the logs of the failed ones and any reruns, and ranks the tests that fail intermittently: "failed 5 of 30 (at least 16%), passed on rerun of 3 commits", with evidence runs and the quoted log line. Tests that fail every run since a commit are reported separately as broken, not flaky. Counts, rates and scores are computed in code, never guessed. For one chosen test it drafts a ticket and a skip-marker pull request (the patch is generated by code) and writes each step (issue, branch, commit, draft PR) only after you approve that one step. On demand in chat; it never re-runs jobs, merges or deletes tests.

skills.name: Flaky test ranking
skills.description: Ranks the flakiest tests over a repository's recent CI runs with computed k-of-n rates, rerun flips and evidence runs; then, for one test, a ticket and a draft pull request that skips it, each write approved on its own card.
examples: Which tests are flaky in acme/shop?
Rank the flakiest tests on the CI workflow in the last 40 runs
